pairs.target: tiān hái méi liàng tòu , sè lā yǐjīng bǎ bǐng sāijìn le bāofú .
pairs.english: Before full daylight, Sela had already tucked the flatbread into the bundle.
pairs.hanzi: 天还没亮透，瑟拉已经把饼塞进了包袱。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hēwán shuǐ , dītóu xì xié .
pairs.english: Tavi finished his water and bent to tie his shoes.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维喝完水，低头系鞋。

pairs.target: zuówǎn bǔguò de dìfāng tiēzhe jiǎodǐ , néng jué chūlái , què bù téng .
pairs.english: Last night's darn rested against his sole; he could feel it, but it did not hurt.
pairs.hanzi: 昨晚补过的地方贴着脚底，能觉出来，却不疼。

pairs.target: tā xì hǎo yìzhī , yòu chāikāi lìngyìzhī zhòng xì ,
pairs.english: He tied one shoe, then undid the other and tied it again,
pairs.hanzi: 他系好一只，又拆开另一只重系，

pairs.target: zhídào ménwài xiǎngqǐ nài lěi qīngqīng qiāomén de shēngyīn .
pairs.english: until Nerai's gentle knock sounded outside the door.
pairs.hanzi: 直到门外响起奈蕾轻轻敲门的声音。

pairs.target: sè lā méiyǒu sòng xià cháng jiē , zhī péi tā zǒu dào xiàngkǒu .
pairs.english: Sela did not accompany him down the long stairs, only as far as the lane's entrance.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉没有送下长阶，只陪他走到巷口。

pairs.target: zhèlǐ néng kànjiàn shuǐgōu shàng dā zhe de shíbǎn ,
pairs.english: From here they could see the stone slab laid across the ditch;
pairs.hanzi: 这里能看见水沟上搭着的石板，

pairs.target: wǎng xià zài guǎi yícì , wūmén jiù kànbújiàn le .
pairs.english: one more turn downward, and the house door would vanish from sight.
pairs.hanzi: 往下再拐一次，屋门就看不见了。

pairs.target: " zhǐ fàng nǎér ? "
pairs.english: “Where are the papers?”
pairs.hanzi: “纸放哪儿？”

pairs.target: tā pāilepāi xiōngqián de bùdài .
pairs.english: He patted the cloth bag against his chest.
pairs.hanzi: 他拍了拍胸前的布袋。

pairs.target: " zhēn ne ? "
pairs.english: “And the needle?”
pairs.hanzi: “针呢？”

pairs.target: " wài dài . búhuì zhā rén . "
pairs.english: “Outer pocket. It won't prick anyone.”
pairs.hanzi: “外袋。不会扎人。”

pairs.target: tā tì tā chěpíng jiāntóu juǎnqǐ de yìdiǎn yīlǐng ,
pairs.english: She straightened the bit of collar curled up at his shoulder,
pairs.hanzi: 她替他扯平肩头卷起的一点衣领，

pairs.target: chě wán , shǒu zài bù shàng tíng le tíng .
pairs.english: and when she had finished, her hand lingered on the cloth.
pairs.hanzi: 扯完，手在布上停了停。

pairs.target: " lùshang chī bǐng , bié liú yìng le . "
pairs.english: “Eat the bread on the way. Don't let it get hard.”
pairs.hanzi: “路上吃饼，别留硬了。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi diǎntóu , zǒu xià liǎngjí yòu huítóu .
pairs.english: Tavi nodded, went down two steps, then looked back.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维点头，走下两级又回头。

pairs.target: sè lā hái zài nàlǐ , bǎishǒu jiào tā zǒu .
pairs.english: Sela was still there, waving him on.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉还在那里，摆手叫他走。

pairs.target: tā zhè cái kànjiàn tā shēnhòu nà miànqiáng yǒu duō ǎi ,
pairs.english: Only then did he see how low the wall behind her was;
pairs.hanzi: 他这才看见她身后那面墙有多矮，

pairs.target: zhàn zài jiālǐ shí , jìng yìzhí juéde tā néng bǎ xiàngzi dōu dǎngzhù .
pairs.english: from inside the house, he had always felt it could block out the whole lane.
pairs.hanzi: 站在家里时，竟一直觉得它能把巷子都挡住。

pairs.target: nài lěi zài xiàmiàn děng tā , méiyǒu cuī .
pairs.english: Nerai waited below without hurrying him.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾在下面等他，没有催。

pairs.target: jiù yìlù cóng huòzhàn xībiān rào shàngqù , qǐxiān yǔ yùnméi de lù bìngxíng .
pairs.english: The old relay road wound up west of the freight station, at first running alongside the coal road.
pairs.hanzi: 旧驿路从货站西边绕上去，起先与运煤的路并行。

pairs.target: zǒuguò dìyīzuò xiējiǎo péng , chēzhé biàn fēn le dào ,
pairs.english: Beyond the first resting shelter, the wheel tracks diverged,
pairs.hanzi: 走过第一座歇脚棚，车辙便分了道，

pairs.target: shíjiē jiàn zhǎi , qiángfèng lǐcháng zhe huī ào méiyǒu de xìyè cǎo .
pairs.english: the stone steps narrowed, and slender-leaved grass unknown in Ash Hollow grew in the wall cracks.
pairs.hanzi: 石阶渐窄，墙缝里长着灰坳没有的细叶草。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tīngjiàn huò tī de tiěsuǒ xiǎng , huítóu zhǎo , què zhī kànjiàn wù .
pairs.english: Tavi heard the freight lift's iron cables, looked back for them, and saw only mist.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维听见货梯的铁索响，回头找，却只看见雾。

pairs.target: nài lěi de xíngnáng bú dà , jiāndài shàng bǔ le liǎngchù .
pairs.english: Nerai's pack was small, its shoulder strap patched in two places.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾的行囊不大，肩带上补了两处。

pairs.target: tā zǒu dé bǐ píngrì màn , gé yíduàn biàn tíngxià ,
pairs.english: She walked more slowly than usual, stopping at intervals,
pairs.hanzi: 她走得比平日慢，隔一段便停下，

pairs.target: ràng tā hēshuǐ , jiǎnchá bāofú yǒuméiyǒu mó jiān .
pairs.english: having him drink and checking whether the bundle was chafing his shoulder.
pairs.hanzi: 让他喝水，检查包袱有没有磨肩。

pairs.target: tā bùhǎoyìsi měicì dōu hē , dìsān huíxiǎng yáotóu , tā yǐjīng jiāng shuǐhú dìguòlái .
pairs.english: Embarrassed to drink every time, he wanted to shake his head at the third stop, but she was already offering the flask.
pairs.hanzi: 他不好意思每次都喝，第三回想摇头，她已经将水壶递过来。

pairs.target: " búshì kǎo nǐ néng bunéng rěn kě . "
pairs.english: “This isn't a test of whether you can endure thirst.”
pairs.hanzi: “不是考你能不能忍渴。”

pairs.target: shuǐ liáng dé yágēn fāsuān .
pairs.english: The cold water made his teeth ache.
pairs.hanzi: 水凉得牙根发酸。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hē le liǎngkǒu , cái fāxiànzìjǐ yìzhí zhāng zhe zuǐ chuǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi took two mouthfuls and only then realized he had been panting with his mouth open.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维喝了两口，才发现自己一直张着嘴喘。

pairs.target: shàngwǔ de wù sàn zài yídào shígǒng xiàmiàn .
pairs.english: The morning mist cleared beneath a stone arch.
pairs.hanzi: 上午的雾散在一道石拱下面。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiān kànjiàn shàngfāng yìtiáo liàngxiàn , yǐwéi shì shī qiáng fǎnguāng , zǒujìn cái tīngjiàn shuǐshēng .
pairs.english: Tavi first saw a bright line overhead, thinking it was light on a wet wall; only closer did he hear water.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维先看见上方一条亮线，以为是湿墙反光，走近才听见水声。

pairs.target: nà shì yìtiáo jià zài lùshang de shuǐqú , qú dǐ bǐ tāmen tóudǐng hái gāo ,
pairs.english: It was an aqueduct crossing above the road, its base higher than their heads,
pairs.hanzi: 那是一条架在路上的水渠，渠底比他们头顶还高，

pairs.target: shuǐshēng cóng shítou shàngfāng chuánlái , yíkèbùtíng .
pairs.english: the sound of water coming from above the stone without a pause.
pairs.hanzi: 水声从石头上方传来，一刻不停。

pairs.target: tā tíng zài gǒng xià , yǎngtóu kàn le hěn jiǔ .
pairs.english: He stopped beneath the arch and gazed upward for a long time.
pairs.hanzi: 他停在拱下，仰头看了很久。

pairs.target: " zhè shuǐ bù wǎng huī ào zǒu ? "
pairs.english: “Doesn't this water go to Ash Hollow?”
pairs.hanzi: “这水不往灰坳走？”

pairs.target: " búshì měi tiáo qú dōu tōng dào xiàmiàn . nàbiān yǒu xùshuǐchí , háiyǒu mòfáng . " nài lěi zhǐxiàng dōngmiàn .
pairs.english: “Not every channel leads down below. There are reservoirs that way, and mills.” Nerai pointed east.
pairs.hanzi: “不是每条渠都通到下面。那边有蓄水池，还有磨坊。”奈蕾指向东面。

pairs.target: tā shùnzhe tā de shǒu kàn guòqù , cái kànjiàn pō hòu háiyǒu yípiàn wūdǐng .
pairs.english: Following her hand, he finally noticed another cluster of roofs beyond the slope.
pairs.hanzi: 他顺着她的手看过去，才看见坡后还有一片屋顶。

pairs.target: gāochù bìng búshì tā xiǎngxiàng de yìcéngcéng táijiē , měi yìcéng zhī wèi tuōzhù zuì shàngmiàn de chéng .
pairs.english: The heights were not the tiers of steps he had imagined, each existing only to hold up the city at the very top.
pairs.hanzi: 高处并不是他想象的一层层台阶，每一层只为托住最上面的城。

pairs.target: nàlǐ yě yǒurén shài cài , yǒu háizi qí zài ǎiqiáng shàng , ná shùzhī qù gòu qú biān shēn xià de téng .
pairs.english: People dried vegetables there too; a child straddled a low wall, reaching with a branch for vines hanging from the channel's edge.
pairs.hanzi: 那里也有人晒菜，有孩子骑在矮墙上，拿树枝去够渠边伸下的藤。

pairs.target: yígè tílán de nǚrén cóng tāmen shēnhòu jīngguò , cháo qiángshàng hǎn le yìshēng .
pairs.english: A woman carrying a basket passed behind them and called toward the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 一个提篮的女人从他们身后经过，朝墙上喊了一声。

pairs.target: háizi bǎ shùzhī yì diū , zìjǐ xiān tiàojìn yuànlǐ .
pairs.english: The child dropped the branch and jumped into the yard first.
pairs.hanzi: 孩子把树枝一丢，自己先跳进院里。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào qǐlái , jīngdòng le gǒng dòng lǐ de yìzhī niǎo .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed, startling a bird inside the arch.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑起来，惊动了拱洞里的一只鸟。

pairs.target: tā yánzhe qú biān fēi zǒu , yǐngzi zài báishí shàng yìshǎnérguò .
pairs.english: It flew off along the channel's edge, its shadow flashing across the white stone.
pairs.hanzi: 它沿着渠边飞走，影子在白石上一闪而过。

pairs.target: guò le shuǐqú , lù zhuǎn dào bèifēng de yímiàn .
pairs.english: Past the aqueduct, the road turned to the sheltered side.
pairs.hanzi: 过了水渠，路转到背风的一面。

pairs.target: wǔjiān , tāmen zài yíchù yǐn mǎcáo páng zuòxià chī bǐng .
pairs.english: At midday they sat beside a horse trough to eat their flatbread.
pairs.hanzi: 午间，他们在一处饮马槽旁坐下吃饼。

pairs.target: nài lěi zài cáo biān kànguò xiǎo pái , lǐng tā dào shàngtóu dúlì de chūshuǐkǒu jiē shuǐ ,
pairs.english: After reading a small sign beside the trough, Nerai led him to a separate spout above it to fill their water,
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾在槽边看过小牌，领他到上头独立的出水口接水，

pairs.target: bù cóng shēngkǒu hē de chílǐ yǎo .
pairs.english: rather than scoop it from the pool the animals drank from.
pairs.hanzi: 不从牲口喝的池里舀。

pairs.target: shícáo páng tíng zhe yíliàng xiǎochē , chēlún chāixiàlái kào zài qiángshàng .
pairs.english: A small cart stood beside the stone trough, its removed wheel leaning against the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 石槽旁停着一辆小车，车轮拆下来靠在墙上。

pairs.target: chēzhǔ yòngbù cā zhóu , tā de érzi dūn zhe dì gōngjù , yāojiān yě guà zhezhuāng zhǐ de bùdài .
pairs.english: The owner wiped the axle with a cloth while his son crouched to pass tools, a cloth bag for papers hanging at his waist too.
pairs.hanzi: 车主用布擦轴，他的儿子蹲着递工具，腰间也挂着装纸的布袋。

pairs.target: nánhái wèn tǎ wéi shìbushì qù bái jiē .
pairs.english: The boy asked whether Tavi was going to White Steps.
pairs.hanzi: 男孩问塔维是不是去白阶。

pairs.target: " shìdú . " tǎ wéi shuō .
pairs.english: “For the trial,” Tavi said.
pairs.hanzi: “试读。”塔维说。

pairs.target: " wǒ yě shì . wǒ niáng běnlái yào lái , jiéguǒ tā zǒubùkāi . "
pairs.english: “Me too. My mother was going to come, but she couldn't get away.”
pairs.hanzi: “我也是。我娘本来要来，结果她走不开。”

pairs.target: tā yìbiān shuō , yìbiān jiāng shǒulǐ de bānshǒu dì cuò le .
pairs.english: As he spoke, he handed over the wrong wrench.
pairs.hanzi: 他一边说，一边将手里的扳手递错了。

pairs.target: chēzhǔ méiyǒu táitóu , tānkāi shǒu děng , nánhái dītóu kànkàn , gǎnjǐn huàn le lìng yìbǎ .
pairs.english: The owner waited with his palm open without looking up; the boy glanced down and quickly swapped it for another.
pairs.hanzi: 车主没有抬头，摊开手等，男孩低头看看，赶紧换了另一把。

pairs.target: " yào tuī ma ? " tǎ wéi wèn .
pairs.english: “Need a push?” Tavi asked.
pairs.hanzi: “要推吗？”塔维问。

pairs.target: " xiān bǎ lún ān huíqù . " nánhái shuō ,
pairs.english: “Put the wheel back first,” the boy said.
pairs.hanzi: “先把轮安回去。”男孩说，

pairs.target: " méi lúnzǐ tuī qǐlái jiù guì le , zhóu yě dé péi . "
pairs.english: “Pushing without a wheel gets expensive. You'd have to pay for the axle too.”
pairs.hanzi: “没轮子推起来就贵了，轴也得赔。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi chàdiǎn bǎ bǐng qiàng jìn bízi . nài lěi bǎ shuǐhú wǎng tā nàbiān yí le yí .
pairs.english: Tavi nearly snorted bread through his nose. Nerai shifted the flask toward him.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维差点把饼呛进鼻子。奈蕾把水壶往他那边移了移。

pairs.target: tāmen xiē dào chēlún zhuāng hǎo , cái zhàn qǐlái dā yìbǎshǒu .
pairs.english: They rested until the wheel was fitted, then stood to lend a hand.
pairs.hanzi: 他们歇到车轮装好，才站起来搭一把手。

pairs.target: chēlǐ zhuāng de bìng bùquánshì xíngli , háiyǒu sònggěi shàngpō pùzi de yánbāo .
pairs.english: The cart held more than luggage: there were sacks of salt for a shop up the slope too.
pairs.hanzi: 车里装的并不全是行李，还有送给上坡铺子的盐包。

pairs.target: tuīshàng píng lù , chēzhǔ biàn ràng tāmen sōngshǒu , shěng zhe lìqi zǒu hòumiàn de jiē .
pairs.english: Once they pushed onto level road, the owner had them let go and save their strength for the steps ahead.
pairs.hanzi: 推上平路，车主便让他们松手，省着力气走后面的阶。

pairs.target: nàliàngchē mànmàn zǒu dào qiánmiàn .
pairs.english: The cart slowly drew ahead.
pairs.hanzi: 那辆车慢慢走到前面。

pairs.target: nánhái zuòshàngqù yìxiǎo huìer , yòu bèi fùqīn jiào xiàlái , zài pángbiān bùxíng .
pairs.english: The boy rode for a little while, then his father called him down to walk beside it.
pairs.hanzi: 男孩坐上去一小会儿，又被父亲叫下来，在旁边步行。

pairs.target: zhuǎnguò wān , hái néng tīngjiàn liǎnggè rén zhēnglùn nǎbiān de lúnzǐ fāngcái xiǎng guò .
pairs.english: Even after the turn, they could hear the two arguing about which wheel had made the noise earlier.
pairs.hanzi: 转过弯，还能听见两个人争论哪边的轮子方才响过。

pairs.target: xiàwǔ de lùshang fēng dà le .
pairs.english: The wind grew stronger on the afternoon road.
pairs.hanzi: 下午的路上风大了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi de jiǎodǐ kāishǐ fārè , nài lěi xuǎn le yíduàn gān táijiē , ràng tā tuōxié kànkàn .
pairs.english: Tavi's soles began to burn; Nerai chose a stretch of dry steps and had him take off his shoes to check.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维的脚底开始发热，奈蕾选了一段干台阶，让他脱鞋看看。

pairs.target: búshì zuótiān bǔ de dìfāng , shì jiǎogēn xīn mó hóng le yìxiǎokuài .
pairs.english: It was not yesterday's darn, but a small patch newly rubbed red on his heel.
pairs.hanzi: 不是昨天补的地方，是脚跟新磨红了一小块。

pairs.target: tā ràng tā bǎ wàzi shàng de zhòuzhě lāpíng ,
pairs.english: She had him smooth the wrinkles in his sock,
pairs.hanzi: 她让他把袜子上的皱褶拉平，

pairs.target: zìjǐ zuòzài pángbiān , jiěkāi jiāndài xià de yíchù jié .
pairs.english: sitting beside him herself to undo a knot beneath her shoulder strap.
pairs.hanzi: 自己坐在旁边，解开肩带下的一处结。

pairs.target: " nǐ yě mó ? "
pairs.english: “Yours chafes too?”
pairs.hanzi: “你也磨？”

pairs.target: " bāo lǐ huàn le bǎifǎ , zǎoshàng méi liúyì . "
pairs.english: “I rearranged the pack and didn't notice this morning.”
pairs.hanzi: “包里换了摆法，早上没留意。”

pairs.target: tā náchū yìběn zhǎi cè , huàn dào lìngyícè , yòu bǎ yìngpí biān bāo hǎo .
pairs.english: She took out a narrow notebook, moved it to the other side, and wrapped its stiff cover edges.
pairs.hanzi: 她拿出一本窄册，换到另一侧，又把硬皮边包好。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànzhe nà běn cèzǐ , hěn xiǎng wèn shàngmiàn yǒuméiyǒu dī dì de shípō ,
pairs.english: Tavi watched the notebook, wanting badly to ask whether it showed the rocky slope in the lowlands,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看着那本册子，很想问上面有没有低地的石坡，

pairs.target: xiǎng le xiǎng , xiān wèn tā háiyào zǒu duōjiǔ .
pairs.english: but after thinking, first asked how much longer they had to walk.
pairs.hanzi: 想了想，先问她还要走多久。

pairs.target: " zài guò liǎngdào wān , jiù néng kànjiàn .
pairs.english: “Two more bends and you'll see it.
pairs.hanzi: “再过两道弯，就能看见。

pairs.target: kànjiàn yǐhòu hái dé zǒu , bié bǎ nàshí de lù lòudiào . "
pairs.english: You'll still have to walk after you see it. Don't forget that part of the road.”
pairs.hanzi: 看见以后还得走，别把那时的路漏掉。”

pairs.target: tā bǎ xié chuān hǎo , guǒrán zài dìèrdào wān hòu kàndào le bái jiē .
pairs.english: He put his shoes on, and sure enough, after the second bend he saw White Steps.
pairs.hanzi: 他把鞋穿好，果然在第二道弯后看到了白阶。

pairs.target: zuìxiān chūxiàn de búshì dàmén , érshì yìpái liàng zài fēng lǐ de lánbù .
pairs.english: What appeared first was not a gate, but a row of blue cloth drying in the wind.
pairs.hanzi: 最先出现的不是大门，而是一排晾在风里的蓝布。

pairs.target: bù hòu shì báishí qìchéng de cháng qiáng , qiángjiǎo yánzhe shānshì zhuǎnguò qù , zhuǎn dào shù hòu réng méiyǒu jìntóu .
pairs.english: Behind it stood a long white-stone wall, its foot turning with the mountain's contours and continuing out of sight behind the trees.
pairs.hanzi: 布后是白石砌成的长墙，墙脚沿着山势转过去，转到树后仍没有尽头。

pairs.target: gèng gāochù lùchū jǐzuò wūdǐng , yízuò yǒu yān , yízuò guà zhe wài shēn de mùjià ,
pairs.english: Several roofs rose higher up: smoke above one, a projecting timber frame hanging from another,
pairs.hanzi: 更高处露出几座屋顶，一座有烟，一座挂着外伸的木架，

pairs.target: háiyǒu yízuò zhǐyǒu bànbiān , bèi jiǎoshǒujià wéizhe .
pairs.english: and one more only half complete, surrounded by scaffolding.
pairs.hanzi: 还有一座只有半边，被脚手架围着。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhànzhù .
pairs.english: Tavi stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维站住。

pairs.target: yuǎnyuǎnwàngqù , nàxiē dìfāng jìng bú xiàng yígè " xuégōng ",
pairs.english: From a distance, the place did not look like a single “academy” at all,
pairs.hanzi: 远远望去，那些地方竟不像一个“学宫”，

pairs.target: dǎoxiàng hǎojǐgè gè zuò gè shì de xiǎoyuàn , bèi chángchángde lángzǐ lián dào le yìqǐ .
pairs.english: but several small courtyards, each busy with its own work, joined by long corridors.
pairs.hanzi: 倒像好几个各做各事的小院，被长长的廊子连到了一起。

pairs.target: fēng jiāng lánbù xiānqǐ lái , qiáng nèi yǒurén hǎn zhe jiào lìngyìrén yāzhù shéng jiǎo .
pairs.english: Wind lifted the blue cloth, and someone inside the wall shouted for another person to hold down the corner rope.
pairs.hanzi: 风将蓝布掀起来，墙内有人喊着叫另一人压住绳角。

pairs.target: nài lěi děng tā kàn wán , chóngxīn bèi hǎo xíngnáng .
pairs.english: Nerai waited for him to finish looking, then shouldered her pack again.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾等他看完，重新背好行囊。

pairs.target: yúxià de lù bǐ liǎngdào wān cháng dé duō .
pairs.english: The remaining road was far longer than two bends.
pairs.hanzi: 余下的路比两道弯长得多。

pairs.target: dào le ménqián , tǎ wéi yǐjīng gùbúshàng xiǎng gāi zěnyàng zhàn dé xiàng gè xuéshēng , zhī xiǎng bǎ bāofú fàngxià .
pairs.english: By the gate, Tavi no longer cared how to stand like a student; he only wanted to put his bundle down.
pairs.hanzi: 到了门前，塔维已经顾不上想该怎样站得像个学生，只想把包袱放下。

pairs.target: ménfáng zhǐ gěi tāmen yìtiáo tōngwǎng dēngjìchù de lángdào ,
pairs.english: The gatekeeper pointed out a corridor leading to registration,
pairs.hanzi: 门房指给他们一条通往登记处的廊道，

pairs.target: gàosù tā shuǐgāng zài dìyīgēn zhùzi hòumiàn .
pairs.english: telling him the water jar was behind the first pillar.
pairs.hanzi: 告诉他水缸在第一根柱子后面。

pairs.target: tā yīyán zǒu guòqù , yǎo le yìwǎnshuǐ .
pairs.english: He went as directed and dipped out a bowl of water.
pairs.hanzi: 他依言走过去，舀了一碗水。

pairs.target: táiqǐ tóu shí , láng nà tóu xiǎngqǐ yízhèn língshēng ,
pairs.english: As he raised his head, bells sounded at the far end of the corridor,
pairs.hanzi: 抬起头时，廊那头响起一阵铃声，

pairs.target: xǔduō rén cóng bùtóng de mén lǐ chūlái , jiǎobùshēng , shuōhuàshēng yíxià tiánmǎn le kōng yuàn .
pairs.english: people emerged from different doors, and footsteps and voices suddenly filled the empty courtyard.
pairs.hanzi: 许多人从不同的门里出来，脚步声、说话声一下填满了空院。

pairs.target: yígè bào zhe mùkuàng de rén cèshēn cóng tā miànqián jǐ guò , shuō le shēng jiè guò .
pairs.english: Someone carrying a wooden frame squeezed sideways past him with an “excuse me.”
pairs.hanzi: 一个抱着木框的人侧身从他面前挤过，说了声借过。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi duān zhe wǎn wǎng lǐ ràng , bāofú pèngdào le zhùzi .
pairs.english: Tavi shifted inward with his bowl, and the bundle bumped the pillar.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维端着碗往里让，包袱碰到了柱子。

pairs.target: zhèhuí língshēng yǐjīng xiǎng wán , tā què hái bù zhīdào zìjǐ gāi wǎng nǎér zǒu .
pairs.english: This time the bells had finished, but he still did not know where he was supposed to go.
pairs.hanzi: 这回铃声已经响完，他却还不知道自己该往哪儿走。

pairs.target: nài lěi zài láng kǒu jiào tā .
pairs.english: Nerai called him from the corridor entrance.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾在廊口叫他。

pairs.target: tā cā qù xiàbā shàng de shuǐ , chóngxīn tíqǐ bāofú , zǒujìn le rénshēng lǐ .
pairs.english: He wiped the water from his chin, lifted the bundle again, and walked into the voices.
pairs.hanzi: 他擦去下巴上的水，重新提起包袱，走进了人声里。
